title: Generate a JSR TypeScript Library
description: Create a new TypeScript library configured for JSR (JavaScript Registry) publishing

name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use?

directory.description: Directory where the library will be created. If not specified, files are generated in the current directory (standalone mode). If specified, a subfolder with the project name will be created.

importPath.x-prompt: What is the JSR import path? (e.g., @scope/package-name)

skipInstall.description: Skip installing dependencies in integrated Nx workspaces

testRunner.description: Test runner to use for the library

x-prompt.message: Which test runner would you like to use?

linter.description: Linter. When omitted, this will be auto-detected from the root package.json. If ambiguous or not found, eslint is used by default.

formatter.description: Code formatter. When omitted, this will be auto-detected. Biome formats and lints. ESLint Stylistic requires eslint as linter. If biome is selected as linter, formatter defaults to biome.
